2609.20104.title: Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model
2609.20104.paper_summary: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc.
2609.20104.paper_summary_zh: 我們描述了Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC的架構、訓練方法和推理加速，這是一個擁有4.7億參數的僅編碼器模型，具有出色的速度與準確性權衡。<lb/>該架構在Conformer區塊中使用金字塔式時間子取樣，採用步進深度卷積、塊對角（分塊）自注意力，並基於中間層的預測進行條件化。<lb/>訓練的亮點包括僅使用公開可用的數據、新穎的Muon優化器使用，以及平衡數據取樣。<lb/>推理加速包括用線性層替換1 x 1卷積，並優化Conformer區塊中的注意力計算。<lb/>總體而言，這導致了一個模型，該模型在英語短語ASR的Open ASR排行榜上位於速度與準確性的Pareto邊界，同時速度是最快競爭者的兩倍。<lb/>該模型可以在寬鬆的許可下使用，並可從https://huggingface.co/ibm-granite/granite-speech-5.0-470m-turboctc下載。
